page.overview:
Who is Hughbert Jellius?

Hughbert Jellius is a male background Earth pony who appears in Hearts and Hooves Day and Slice of Life. He has a gray coat, light yellow mane, light blue eyes, and a cutie mark of three strawberries. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise.

Hughbert Jellius shares his body type with Prince Blueblood, Blue Moon, Dance Fever, Bushel, Chocolate Sun, "South Pole", "Persnickety", "Hay Fever", "Star Dream / Sky Dream", S05E10 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #2, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #6, "Apple Slice", S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #5, and S05E10 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #3 and his coat and mane colors with Derpy, S04E07 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, and "Dipsy".

An Enterplay collectible card game developer and trading card writer posted about Hughbert Jellius as part of April Fools' Day 2015 on Equestria Daily.

Hughbert Jellius appears in Slice of Life. DJ Pon-3 and Octavia Melody pick him, Button Mash, and Dance Fever up on their way to Cranky Doodle Donkey and Matilda's wedding before he and the other ponies they picked up are sent flying into Ponyville Town Hall for the wedding.
